description: Stream your gaming PC to any device with a browser

script: # The elevated helpers must run from the administrator-protected native installation.
# Resolve the real account authority; USERDOMAIN may be stale after a computer rename.

if (!(Invoke-ExternalCommand -FilePath "$dir\setup.exe" -ArgumentList $arguments -RunAs -ContinueExitCodes @{ 3010 = 'Restart required to finish installing native components' })) { throw 'MoonlightWeb native installation failed. See native-install.log.' }
if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath "$nativeDir\MoonlightWeb.exe")) { throw "Native executable was not installed: $nativeDir\MoonlightWeb.exe" }
# Launch the real Program Files path: upstream matches helper tasks against its process path.
# Detach the junction before Scoop removes an old version directory.
if ($nativeLink.LinkType -ne 'Junction') { throw "Refusing to remove an unexpected native path: $dir\native" }
# Windows PowerShell 5.1 prompts on non-empty junctions; remove only the link without recursion.

if (!(Invoke-ExternalCommand -FilePath $uninstaller -ArgumentList @('/VERYSILENT', '/SUPPRESSMSGBOXES', '/NORESTART') -RunAs -ContinueExitCodes @{ 3010 = 'Restart required to finish removing native components' })) { throw 'MoonlightWeb native uninstallation failed.' }

notes: This package runs the official installer with elevation and installs native components under Program Files. Scoop manages updates and keeps AppData in its persist directory.

On x64, the installer adds MoonlightWeb Virtual Display for headless streaming, its helper tasks, worker service, runtime and firewall rules. ARM64 does not include a virtual display driver; a connected display is required.
Launch MoonlightWeb and open its local HTTPS address. The virtual display is disabled when idle and is activated when a stream opens its card. Restart Windows if driver installation requests it.
Use Scoop to manage updates instead of the in-app installer. Uninstalling this package also removes the native installation and its drivers; persisted settings are kept.
